content: वसन्तः [वस्-झच् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 128</ls>] .²1 The spring, vernal season (comprising the two months चैत्र and वैशाख); मधुमाधवौ वसन्तः <ls>Suśr.</ls>; सर्वं प्रिये चारुतरं वसन्ते <ls>Ṛs. 6. 2</ls>; विहरति हरिरिह सरसवसन्ते <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>. .²2 Spring personified as a deity and regarded as a companion of Kāmadeva; सुहृदः पश्य वसन्त किं स्थितम् <ls>Ku. 4. 27</ls>. .²3 Dysentery. .²4 Smallpox. .²5 (In dramas) A nickname for the Vidūṣaka or buffoon.
